params.name: lat
params.description:
Returns maps from e-rara and e-maps on which the defined point is located.

Example: lat=47.349952

params.name: lon
params.description:
Returns maps from e-rara and e-maps on which the defined point is located.

Example: lon=8.490838

params.name: q
params.description:
Returns the data for the search term (q).The parameter "q" is alternative to "lat"/"lon".

Example: q=kyburg
